title: Round 8 (v8): grouped inner-CV (P3) as default tuning; Q1 dense-SNP gain on unseen settings, Q2 robustness of the 'no within-env EC gain' finding across EC specifications, Q3 tuning-protocol audit (descriptive)
status: FROZEN after R7 results, before any R8 analysis. Results already seen under P3 (S0/S1 dense SNP; S1/S2/S3 M0plus vs M_G) are labelled REPLICATION and never enter a confirmatory gate.

penalty_grid.fix: v7 grid omitted 1e-2..1e0 (design error, see R7 H3); v8 grid spans 1e-2..1e7. Report edge-selection fraction per model x setting; grid is NOT extended after results.

default_tuning: P3 grouped inner CV exactly as v7 (S1/S3: leave-one-training-year-out; S2: 4-fold over training location folds; S4: see below). P1 and P2 reported as references.

settings.S4_G2F_CV00: new-year AND new-location: for each held-out year y (2014..2021) and location fold k (v7 S2 folds), test = envs with year y and location in fold k; training = envs with year != y AND location not in fold k. Test cells with no env meeting the >=30 genotyped-hybrid rule are skipped. P3 inner CV = leave-one-training-year-out within the training set. Every env is tested once.

Q1_dense_snp_mainline.models: M0plus_2k, M0plus_98k, M_G, M_G_98k on the Lima common population (as R6/R7)
Q1_dense_snp_mainline.quantity: Delta_98k(P3) = r(M0plus_98k) - r(M0plus_2k); secondary Delta_98k_MG(P3) = r(M_G_98k) - r(M_G)
Q1_dense_snp_mainline.CONFIRMED: Delta_98k(P3) >= 0.01 with paired env-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0 in BOTH confirmatory settings
Q1_dense_snp_mainline.decision: CONFIRMED -> 98k SNP + P3 become the main-line default; otherwise report the setting-specific gain and keep 2k

Q2_EC_specification_robustness.reference: M_G (2k SNP main effects only), tuned by P3

specifications.A_M0plus: as R7 (SNP + PC1..30 x EC_env + predicted maturity x EC_env) - REPLICATION only
specifications.B_PC200xEC: SNP main + PC1..200 x EC_env (standardized EC, PCs from all genotyped hybrids without phenotypes; BRIWECS: min(200, n_cultivars-1) PCs) + predicted maturity x EC_env; two penalty blocks: main lambda from grid, interaction lambda = lambda x {0.1, 1, 10}
specifications.C_SNPxEnvIndex: JGRA-type reaction norm: SNP main + SNP x e_hat, where e_hat is the env-mean yield predicted by a ridge of env-mean yield on EC_env fitted on the fold's training envs (penalty chosen by the same inner folds); two penalty blocks as B
specifications.D_NL_env: two-stage: stage 1 = M_G (P3-tuned); stage 2 = HistGradientBoosting (learning_rate 0.05, max_leaf_nodes 31, min_samples_leaf 200, random_state 20260928) on cross-fitted stage-1 residuals with features EC_env + PC1..30 + predicted maturity; number of iterations chosen from {50,100,200,400,800} by the same P3 inner folds

Q2_EC_specification_robustness.quantity: Delta_spec = r(spec) - r(M_G), both P3-tuned, per setting
Q2_EC_specification_robustness.multiplicity: Holm across the 3 new specifications (B, C, D) within each setting
Q2_EC_specification_robustness.EC_GAIN_EXISTS: any new specification with Delta >= 0.01 and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 (and CI lower > 0) in >= 2 of 3 settings -> report that specification as the EC route of the main line
Q2_EC_specification_robustness.NO_WITHIN_ENV_EC_GAIN: for every new specification, the 95% CI upper bound of Delta < 0.01 in >= 2 of 3 settings -> robust negative finding enters the C paper

Q3_tuning_audit.report: for every setting x model: r under P1, P2, P3; losses P2-P1 and P2-P3 with CIs; fraction of folds with edge-selected lambda; model-ranking changes across protocols

metric_and_uncertainty: within-env Pearson of yield, equal-weight mean over out-of-fold test envs; paired env bootstrap 2000, seed 20260928; Spearman and new-hybrid subset reported
compute: threads <=4 per process, resident memory <5 GB per process; two processes may run concurrently; write per-setting checkpoints so interrupted runs can resume
reporting_rules: results frozen as JSON with sha256
